claim: A 2026 bioRxiv preprint reports that EBV can reprogram autoreactive anti-CNS B cells as antigen-presenting cells in MS.
future_grounding_route: Treat as a future-source candidate only: if it becomes peer reviewed or data are accessible, test whether EBV-linked anti-CNS B-cell APC state maps to the project's IFN/APC modules under predefined autoimmune specificity controls.

project_finding_reference.finding_id: EBV/IFN APC imprint downgraded by specificity control

project_use: Sharper but lower-strength EBV/APC context for V50. It is explicitly a preprint context record, not project evidence and not a finding.
relationship_note: This source is closer to the EBV/APC hypothesis than generic EBV-risk literature, but preprint status and lack of project rerun keep it as future-grounding context only.

source.citation: EBV reprograms autoreactive anti-CNS B cells as antigen presenting cells in multiple sclerosis. bioRxiv preprint. 2026.
source.label: bioRxiv EBV anti-CNS B-cell APC preprint

source_terms.license_or_terms_label: PubMed/preprint bibliographic metadata and short paraphrase only

why_unverifiable: The project has not rerun the preprint's data or validated the claim in held data; preprint status further limits evidentiary use.
